slides.narration: Chapter 22: The Dark Sector. The tower does not stop at stage six. Stage seven has thirteen positions and its own complete set of forces and particles — invisible to us, but gravitationally real. This is dark matter.

Dark matter is not a mysterious substance added to explain galaxy rotation. It is the next stage of the same tower — stage seven, screened from view by one additional layer of the Drishti bound. Same axioms, same structure, one stage deeper.

The dark sector contains about 85 percent of all matter. It is thermally isolated from our sector — the Higgs portal coupling is too weak for detection by current experiments. The framework predicts this isolation quantitatively.
